name: up-next
description: After every turn, Up Next recommends the one step worth taking next, checked against what the turn actually did, sendable as written and never risky, and runs it in one click. Works in the desktop app and the terminal, and through /next.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to advise after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip advice after answers shorter than this many characters.

showReason.title: Show the reason
showReason.description: Show why the step is worth doing under it, and in the status line.

groundAdvice.title: Ground advice in the turn's tool calls
groundAdvice.description: Note which files were edited and which checks (tests, type checks, lint, build) ran or failed this turn, and tell the advisor. Held in memory for the turn only.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the advisor which skills and slash commands this session has, so a step can be one of them. A step naming a command the session does not have is dropped.

row.title: Card above the message box
row.description: auto draws the card where ghost text cannot show (the desktop app); always draws it in the terminal too, beside the ghost text; off never draws it. /next works either way.
